note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for parts + defect taxonomy. Every module (annotate_aes2, teach_cups, build_pt, run_pt) reads names / severity / colors from here via taxonomy.py. To add or rename a defect, edit ONLY this file, then run: python qms.py build.
note_defects: Bearing Cup uses domain-standard metal-forming defect names; Bracket uses the domain-standard electroplating/surface-finish names from the dataset. Legacy/generic names are kept as aliases so older data still resolves.

Edge Chip.description: A bite of material missing from a rolled edge - the outline steps inward or looks torn/faceted instead of a smooth continuous curve.

Dent.description: A localised inward deformation of the rim or flange face that does not remove material.

Out-of-Round.description: Central bore is not a clean circle - one side pinched, dented inward or ovalised (out-of-round).

Nick.description: A small raised nub, square tab, or bite/indentation breaking the smooth curve of an edge or the inner collar rim.

Corrosion.description: Brown/orange mottled corrosion or rust on the drawn wall or face.

Discoloration.description: Discrete dark/discoloured smudge or burn on the metal face; darker than surrounding metal and NOT a shadow.

Reject Mark.description: Deliberate red/pink inspection paint marking where an operator flagged a problem. Secondary marker - hunt the adjacent real defect.

Black Mark After Electroplating.description: Dark/black blemish left on the surface after the electroplating process.

Electroplating Defect.description: A flaw in the electroplated finish - uneven, pitted, blistered or missing plating.

Incomplete Embossing.description: Embossed feature is not fully formed - shallow, partial or missing impression.

Line Defect.description: A long straight line/streak flaw across the surface.

Serration.description: Saw-tooth / jagged serrated deformation along an edge.

OK.description: No defect present - the part passes inspection.
